title: Make room for one thing.
body: Type your intention once. Settle in. Begin when ready.
alt: An intention card reading Write the first page, with a Start button.

title: Follow your own rhythm.
body: Focus counts up. You decide when to stop.
alt: A Focus clock at 12:48 with 2 minutes 34 seconds earned rest and a reminder to park a thought.

title: Rest. Reflect. Return.
body: Your focus earns your break. Leave an optional next step.
alt: A ten-minute Break ring. The example shows fifty minutes of focus earning ten minutes of rest at the default five-to-one ratio.
